name: .243 Cal-083gr Stone Hammer®
note: Recommended use: Small to Big Game Hunting. The product page also says: "This Stone Hammer™ bullet is designed with a 2.5mm hollow point for easy opening on small to big game. With an 80% weight retention this bullet will work very well for big game hunting. This Stone Hammer™ has a little longer nose and shorter baring surface giving it a little better bc." The product name says 83 gr; the specification says 80 gr.
